title: Cursor User Rules have no effect on Inline Edit (Cmd+K) or Tab completions
symptoms: Cmd+K edits ignore style preferences that Agent follows
Tab suggestions ignore the conventions in rules
cause: User Rules are used only by Agent (Chat), and rules in general do not affect Tab or the other AI features.
fix: Enforce must-have conventions in tooling that runs on every change, such as a formatter and linter, and restate the preference in the Cmd+K prompt.
